REPLY BRIEF IN SUPPORT OF ITS MOTION TO COMPEL, STAY ARBITRATION PENDING RESOLUTION OF TH UNDERLYING TUIAKI ACTION; STAY PLTF'S SUIT FOR BREACH OF CONTRACT FILED BY DEFENDANT CHARTER OAK FIRE INSURANCE COMPANY
MINI-MINUTES FOR AUG-13-2008 9:30 AM FOR DEPT 301

LAW AND MOTION 301, AFTER THE ARGUMENT, THE COURT ADOPTED ITS TENTATIVE RULING AS FOLLOWS: DEFENDANT THE CHARTER OAK FIRE INSURANCE COMPANY'S MOTION TO 1)COMPEL ARBITRATION 2) STAY ARBITRATION PENDING RESOLUTION OF THE UNDERLYING TUIAKI ACTION AND 3) STAY PLAINTIFF'S SUIT FOR BREACH OF CONTRACT IS GRANTED. WHETHER DEFENDANT HAS BREACHED ITS PAYMENT OBLIGATION AT THIS TIME IS A REMAINING UNRESOLVED ISSUE BETWEEN PLAINTIF AND DEFENDANT WHICH THE PARTIES HAVE AGREED TO ARBITRATE UPON RESOLUTION OF THE TUIAKI ACTION TO WHICH THEY OR THEIR INSUREDS ARE PARTIES. THEREFORE, ARBITRATION IS ORDERED BUT IS STAYED PENDING RESOLUTION OF THE TUIAKI ACTION AND THIS ACTION IS STAYED PENDING THE ARBITRATION. PREVAILING PARTY IS TO PREPARE A FORM OF ORDER. JUDGE: PETER J. BUSCH, REPORTER: CAROL KAREN CSR # 8189 (301/PJB)
